description: The chart presents dataset statistics by showing sample counts for four essay genres, with counts split into two dataset types labeled in the legend as Open (open-ended) and Cons. (constrained). The horizontal axis contains the genre categories in the order Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, while the vertical axis is labeled “Sample Count” and uses a linear numeric scale with tick marks shown at regular 20-unit intervals (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120), with bars extending up to just above 120 and reaching 130. For each genre, two side-by-side bars are displayed: the Open bar is light blue and the Cons. bar is light pink. In Argumentative, the Open bar is labeled 79 and the Cons. bar is labeled 122; in Narrative, the Open bar is labeled 80 and the Cons. bar is labeled 87; in Descriptive, the Open bar is labeled 68 and the Cons. bar is labeled 100; and in Expository, the Open bar is labeled 62 and the Cons. bar is labeled 130. The bars are grouped by genre with Open consistently on the left and Cons. on the right within each group, and each bar has its exact value annotated in bold text above the bar top; no additional sorting cues beyond the displayed genre order or other visual emphasis (such as outlines or shading differences beyond color) are indicated.
